slots.hypothesis: Minute tick-rule net buying pressure. It is the bounded, scale-free core of the cleanest head, abs_(ts_mean(K,20)) at +0.713: necessity +2.23, rho_known < 0.18, valid/train 1.15, and the score still rises with window length (10/20/40 = -0.32/+0.71/+1.07). The 1-head family is added to the controls. There are 16 seeds whose outer layers were never seen before, in four groups. (1) Split the magnitude: separate buy and sell legs, the idiosyncratic part after demeaning within size deciles, and the persistence share |mean|/mean|.|. (2) How the sign is built: heaviest-10%-minute direction minus the whole day, late-weighted minus equal-weighted, morning session minus the whole day, and |Ret|-soft-weighted (BVC) minus the hard sign. (3) Flow vs price: LMSW-style correlation of lagged flow with next-day return, feedback on the prior day's relative return, same-day alignment, and Kyle lambda ranked within known-liquidity deciles. (4) Events and deviations: flow on volume-spike days, the 5-day z-score against 60 days, and flow rank minus return rank. Literature: Easley-LdP-O'Hara 2016, Chordia-Roll-Subrahmanyam 2002, LMSW 2002, Campbell-Grossman-Wang 1993, Barclay-Warner 1993, Kyle 1985, Bogousslavsky 2021.

The intraday volume clock. The same-day value is noise (-0.09), but its 20-day persistent component gives +1.244. It is the core of the top head (+1.227) and of C (+0.884), and both are added as family controls. About half of the clock's position is liquidity (rho_known -0.512 once smoothed), so all 13 seeds leave the average position behind, in four groups. (1) Second moments: dispersion ranked within known-liquidity deciles, and the coefficient of variation (after Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Anshuman 2001). (2) Relative to its own history and to the market: the 5-day z-score against 60 days and its magnitude, correlation with the market-average clock, and lag-1 autocorrelation (Bialkowski-Darolles-Le Fol 2008). (3) Co-movement with other daily quantities: the day's return, abnormal volume, net buying, and volatility (Admati-Pfleiderer 1988). (4) Clock shape: time of the heaviest 10% of minutes minus the centroid, the Amt clock minus the Volume clock, and |size-decile-demeaned 20-day clock| as a U-shape (Freyberger-Neuhierl-Weber 2020). Seeds avoid sign(), state parameters and reg-x positions.
